subject: general
question: What is the theme of International Civil Aviation Day 2025?

options.text: Safe Skies. Sustainable Future: Together for All
Future Air Mobility & Innovation in the Skies

solution:
The correct answer is __**Safe Skies. Sustainable Future: Together for All**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

 
• International Civil Aviation Day is observed on **7 December** every year.
 
• It commemorates the founding of the **International Civil Aviation Organisation (ICAO)**.
